# requirements-lock.txt: lockfile generated by uv to pin exact package versions
# This file is intentionally omitted from tracking because it can be restored with
# `uv sync -l` or `pip freeze`.  It is provided for reproducibility in CI.
#
# Example content for a pip‑freeze style lockfile:
#
# numpy==1.26.4
# pandas==2.2.1
# pyarrow==14.0.2
# numba==0.59.0
# torch==2.3.0
# matplotlib==3.8.2
# scipy==1.12.0
# pytest==8.2.0

# (replace the version numbers above with your exact builds)
#
# The lockfile is not checked into the repo automatically.
